title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
abstract: arXiv:2609.21157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for chip design, but most existing approaches operate directly at RTL. We ask whether agents can design better chips by leveraging higher-level abstractions. We compare Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, Post-Compiler HLS Refinement, and Post-HLS RTL Refinement, and combine Agent-based HLS Design with Post-HLS RTL Refinement as Agent-based HLS with RTL Refinement (AHRR). We use FPGAs as a practical, easy-to-deploy platform for end-to-end evaluation, but note that the design-flow tradeoffs we study are largely independent of the target technology. Across a diverse 11-tasks benchmark suite, AHRR achieves a 2.6$\times$ geometric-mean speedup over Direct RTL Design across our benchmark suite. translated_title: 智能体能否借助更高层次的抽象设计出更好的芯片？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正被越来越多地探索应用于芯片设计，但大多数现有方法直接在RTL（寄存器传输级）层面进行操作。我们探究智能体能否通过利用更高层次的抽象来设计出更好的芯片。我们比较了直接RTL设计、基于智能体的高层次综合（HLS）设计、编译器后HLS优化以及HLS后RTL优化，并将基于智能体的HLS设计与HLS后RTL优化相结合，提出了“带RTL优化的基于智能体的HLS设计”（AHRR）。我们使用FPGA作为实用且易于部署的平台进行端到端评估，但我们所研究的设计流程权衡在很大程度上与目标工艺技术无关。在一个包含11个任务的多样化基准测试套件中，AHRR相比直接RTL设计实现了2.6倍的几何平均加速。案例研究表明，HLS将设计知识提炼成智能体可以利用的抽象，而RTL优化则能恢复更低层次的优化机会。
tldr: 该论文提出将基于智能体的HLS设计与RTL优化相结合的AHRR方法，证明智能体借助高层次抽象进行芯片设计可相比直接RTL设计获得2.6倍的几何平均加速。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AHRR, which combines agent-based HLS design with post-HLS RTL refinement, demonstrating that agents leveraging higher-level abstractions can achieve a 2.6× geometric-mean speedup over direct RTL design.
